sentences.text: Dialister succinatiphilus, a Dialister species isolated from human faeces, was described as an anaerobic coccobacillus that stains Gram-negative and is asaccharolytic, producing only traces of lactate and propionate.
The same description reports that this strain was able to decarboxylate succinate to propionate.

A large population cohort study, the Flemish Gut Flora Project, reported that Dialister, together with Coprococcus species, was depleted in depression even after correcting for antidepressant effects.
In patients with spondyloarthritis, a study reported that Dialister may represent a potential microbial marker of disease activity.
Dialister invisus was proposed as a novel species for strains isolated from root canals of patients with endodontic infections and from a deep periodontal pocket.
